title: 174. Minimum Size Subarray Sum

examples.explanation: The subarray [4,3] has the minimal length 2.
The subarray [4] has the minimal length 1.
There is no subarray with sum >= 11.

hints: Use a sliding window with left and right pointers and a running sum.
Expand right to reach the target, then shrink left to minimize the length while staying >= target.
